results.title: Fern
results.snippet: Transforms API definitions into production-ready SDKs. fern generate runs generators in the cloud; fern generate --local runs generators in docker locally. Apache 2.0. fernapi/fern-typescript-sdk generator.

results.title: Speakeasy
results.snippet: A Modern OpenAPI Native Toolchain. Generates type-safe SDKs in 10 languages including TypeScript. CLI locally installable (Homebrew/Winget/Docker). Open source. Also has hosted app.speakeasy.com.

results.title: openapi-typescript CLI
results.snippet: npx openapi-typescript schema.yaml -o schema.d.ts. Supports --check (verify generated types up-to-date for CI). Parses local and remote schemas. No watch flag. Multi-file $ref via Redocly bundle.

results.title: openapi-fetch
results.snippet: Thin wrappers around native fetch API. 6 kB. Type-safe request body, query params, path params, response data+error. No built-in axios.

results.title: openapi-typescript advanced
results.snippet: Supports OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 including discriminators. oneOf/anyOf/allOf composition; TypeScript unions do not provide XOR so oneOf recommended alone. --default-non-nullable true.

results.title: OpenAPI Generator generators
results.snippet: TypeScript client generators: typescript-axios, typescript-fetch, typescript-node, typescript-angular, typescript-rxjs, typescript (experimental). Last updated Jul 18 2026.

results.title: OpenAPI Generator
results.snippet: npm wrapper @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli is a cross-platform wrapper around the .jar artifact. JVM required unless using Docker image. Apache 2.0.
